newsitem.title: UK: MC rates Russia's Svyazinform Nizhny Novogorod buy.
newsitem.headline: MC rates Russia's Svyazinform Nizhny Novogorod buy.

text.p: MC Securities has initiated cover of Russian regional telephone company Svyazinform Nizhny Novogorod with a buy recommendation.
"This is a relatively new company with an attractive and clearly-defined strategy," analyst Natalia Ivanova said in a research note.
At $2.77 per shares the company is trading on a price earnings ratio of 2.41 times for 1996 earnings, which MC forecasts will rise 60-70 percent to 1997.

"Having caught up with its relatively more expensive Russian peers, Svyazinform will then take part in (and probably lead) any general rerating of Russian telecommunications stocks, bringing them in to line with their east European counterparts," Ivanova said.
The company has a 36 percent return on sales and revenue per line of $135.
Line penetration in the Nizhny Novgorod region in 14.5 per 100 people, below the Russian average of 18.2 per 100.
